seo.title: Our Team — Verde Law Immigration Attorneys
seo.description: Meet the Verde Law attorneys, paralegals, and support team fighting for immigrant families across the country.

team.title: The people fighting for your family.
team.subtitle: Two attorneys, four paralegals, and a support team that treats every phone call like it matters — because it does.
team.supportTitle: The people who keep the doors open.

rafael-verde.p1: Rafael Verde founded Verde Law in 2024 — weeks after passing the bar and with one belief: that immigrants in the United States deserved the same caliber of representation the corporate world takes for granted.
rafael-verde.p2: Before founding the firm he spent his law school years interning at Miami-Dade's Public Defender's Office and at a federal immigration clinic, where he took on detained clients pro bono while most of his classmates were prepping for biglaw summers.
rafael-verde.p3: Today he personally reviews every new case at Verde Law, argues merits hearings across the Eleventh Circuit, and runs a TikTok that's taught over 61,000 people their rights under U.S. immigration law.

barAdmissions.label: Bar Admissions
barAdmissions.value: Florida Bar · U.S. Court of Appeals, Eleventh Circuit · U.S. District Court, Southern District of Florida

jennifer-colon.p1: Jennifer Colón Rodríguez joined Verde Law as an associate attorney in 2025 after five years of humanitarian work with immigrant survivors of violence. Her practice focuses on VAWA, U-Visa, and SIJS cases.
jennifer-colon.p2: She is a native Spanish speaker, a graduate of the University of Puerto Rico School of Law, and a trauma-informed interviewer certified by the Vera Institute of Justice. Clients regularly say she is the first attorney who made them feel safe enough to tell their full story.
jennifer-colon.p3: Jennifer leads the firm's VAWA practice and supervises the paralegal team on humanitarian filings.

education.label: Education
education.value: University of Puerto Rico School of Law · J.D., 2020

teamBios.aniela: Aniela handles bond and detained matters, working directly with families from the moment a loved one is taken into ICE custody.
teamBios.mayerli: Mayerli manages asylum and VAWA files, and prepares personal declarations alongside the attorneys.
teamBios.flor: Flor coordinates family-based petitions, consular processing, and USCIS filings from intake to approval.
teamBios.alba: Alba supports our removal defense practice with evidence gathering, court filings, and client communication.
teamBios.daliana: Daliana keeps the firm running day to day — scheduling, vendor relationships, and the small things that matter to clients.
teamBios.jeanine: Jeanine runs our intake team, which means she's usually the first person you talk to when you call.
teamBios.yunetsy: Yunetsy handles billing with the transparency our clients deserve — clear invoices, flexible payment plans, zero surprises.
teamBios.vianney: Vianney leads our marketing and community outreach, including the TikTok education channel that reaches tens of thousands of immigrants every week.

join.title: Work with us.
join.body: We're hiring attorneys, paralegals, and bilingual intake specialists. If you want to practice immigration law the right way — with real resources, flat fees, and a team that respects your time — we'd like to meet you.
